title: 54:5 thy husband. Once again the Lord identifies himself as the husband of Israel, or the righteous (50:1; 62:5; Matt. 25:1-13; 2 Cor. 11:1-4; Rev. 19:7-9; D&C 33:17; 133:10, 19). When the Lord returns to redeem Zion, he will be as a loving and tender bridegroom coming to claim his beloved bride.
author: Tina M. Peterson
